0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Boston Celtics visit the Detroit Pistons. Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with illness, while Detroit is missing Taurean Prince, who is out for personal reasons. The Celtics lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, and their most recent meeting, on January 19, 2026 in Detroit, ended in a 104-103 Boston loss.
